newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS- Earnings, deals move shares.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS- Earnings, deals move shares.

text.p: REGENCY HEALTH SERVICES INC - Shares rise after Regency agrees to be acquired by Sun Healthcare Group Inc in a deal valued about $589 million. Regency Health gained 4-13/16, while Sun Healthcare gained 1-1/2 to 21-5/8.
DONNA KARAN INTERNATIONAL INC - Shares jump after Donna Karan handed over the reins of her design house to a former Polo Ralph Lauren Corp executive John Idol. Up 1-4/16 to 11-11/16.

INGLES MARKETS INC - Slips after the supermarket chain operator said on Friday it expects its third quarter primary earnings per share to range between $0.21 a share and $0.23 a share, which is below the current analyst consensus. Smith Barney downgraded the stock to neutral from outperform. Stock off 2-7/8 to 13-3/4.

LINCOLN NATIONAL CORP - Said it will buy CIGNA Corp's individual life insurance and annuity business for about $1.4 billion in cash. Lincoln Nation said the deal should immediately add to its 1998 earnings. CIGNA said it expects to use the proceeds from the sale of the business to repurchase its shares. Shares of Lincoln National gain 1-6/16 to 68-13/16. CIGNA gains 4-1/4 to 195-1/4.

CHIPS AND TECHNOLOGIES INC - Shares of the computer graphics supplier rise after the company agreed to be acquired by Intel Corp for $397 million. Chips and Technologies shares gains 3-1/16 to 17-1/16. Intel loses 15/16 to 88-1/4.
APPLE SOUTH INC - Posted second quarter earnings of $0.27 a share compared to $0.25 a share. Sales increased to $202.8 million from $136.9 million. Gains 1-3/16 to 14-7/8.
WESTINGHOUSE ELECTRIC CORP - Reported second quarter earnings of $1.0 million compared with a loss of $89 million a year ago. Sales rose to $2.41 billion from $2.15 billion. Gains 1/8 to 24-1/2.
